response.justification: Bogdan is a skilled full-stack engineer with proven leadership capabilities, but represents a fundamental misalignment with this role's core requirements. The position mandates 8 years of C++ programming as a primary qualifier; the resume shows approximately 6 months of C++ work at National Instruments and scattered references elsewhere. More critically, Bogdan's career trajectory emphasizes web services, full-stack development, and general software engineering, whereas this role requires deep expertise in large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and compute platform architecture. While his leadership skills and testing practices are strengths, they cannot offset the substantial technical skill gaps in the focus areas.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership through multiple staff roles and successful creation of GISCollective, an open-source distributed platform
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing practices (TDD, CI/CD), and mentoring through workshops and community engagement
Production-scale systems experience including microservices infrastructure at Dunnhumby and AWS CDK work at Optilyz
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise with only ~6 months documented experience versus required 8 years, a core technical requirement
Career trajectory heavily weighted toward web/full-stack development (Node.js, TypeScript) rather than infrastructure and compute platforms
Limited evidence of mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers, or leading teams specifically focused on large-scale infrastructure platforms
